title: 第11章 上山打工第12章 忙点儿好啊
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 炼化一只十三境的邪修鬼灵，让王易突破到了炼气六层的境界。
他距离炼气后期也只有一步之遥。
“该出门干活儿了。”
陈清月不在附近，不知道什么时候离开，也不清楚去了哪里。
王易打了个哈欠，然后站起身，走出破庙。
他沿着山间小路，又去了太一宗门内闲逛。
这是王易第三次入宗，不知道又会有怎样的收获。
太一宗后山，一片郁郁葱葱的竹林中。
两个年岁相近的青年正在窃窃私语，密谋交谈着什么。
“王师兄，咱们是不是有些谨慎过头了？”
刘启元摇头叹气：“我都守在山门口十几天了，也没看见她一个人影，一根头发啊。”
“要我说，陈清月早就死了，那个邪修心狠手辣，本事也不小，没理由阴沟里翻船。”
王天权却面无表情，反问了一句：“消息呢？尸体呢？”
“活要见人死要见尸，他追杀陈师妹，但结果却是一起失踪……你如何就敢断定，死的是陈清月，不是那家伙？”
刘启元挠挠头：“但就算像师兄你担心的那样，他被陈清月反杀了，陈师妹有什么理由不回宗门复命呢？”
“任务失败，同门师兄惨死，她最多就是被关三四个月的禁闭，何至于躲到现在还不敢回来？”
王天权沉默无言，也没有想到一个合理的解释。
这两人自然是不清楚，对陈清月来说宗门罪责事小，三个月的禁闭时间才是无法接受的结果。
因为再过一个月，第三扇石门就要开启了。
陈清月绝不可能允许那份最重要的黑莲仙缘落入他人之手。
所以她才回到柳州城，找了一个代替魏千城的倒霉蛋。
不需要瞒一世，瞒住一时就足够了。
宗门内没人能认出来魏千城，只要等一个月的时间，黑莲石门开启，陈清月就能偷偷取走仙缘。
然后，海阔凭鱼跃，天高任鸟飞。
天下之大，她何处不能去？
至于留在太一宗的那个倒霉蛋，就只能自求多福，自生自灭了。
王天权抬了抬眼，慢声说道：“我怀疑陈师妹杀了那家伙之后发现了一些苗头，所以才不敢回山。”
刘启元耸耸肩，问：“那不是更好？”
“只要她不回太一宗，逃去哪儿都和咱们没关系，反正时间也快到了……”
王天权微微颔首，他说的倒也没错。
content_en:
Refining a thirteenth-level evil cultivator ghost allowed Wang Yi to break through to the sixth level of Qi refining.
He is only one step away from the late stage of Qi refining.
"It's time to go out to work."
Chen Qingyue was not nearby. She didn’t know when she left or where she went.
Wang Yi yawned, then stood up and walked out of the ruined temple.
He walked along the mountain path and wandered inside the Taiyi Sect.
This is Wang Yi's third time joining the sect, and he doesn't know what he will gain.
…
In the back mountain of Taiyizong, there is a lush bamboo forest.
Two young men of similar age were whispering and conspiring about something.
"Senior Brother Wang, are we a little too cautious?"
Liu Qiyuan shook his head and sighed: "I have been guarding the mountain gate for more than ten days, and I haven't seen a single figure or hair of hers."
"If you ask me, Chen Qingyue has been dead a long time ago. That evil cultivator is ruthless and capable. There is no reason for him to capsize in the gutter."
Wang Tianquan had no expression on his face and asked: "Where's the news? Where's the body?"
"He wanted to see a dead person or a dead body. He chased Junior Sister Chen, but the result was that they disappeared together... How do you dare to conclude that it was Chen Qingyue who died, not that guy?"
Liu Qiyuan scratched his head: "But even if he is killed by Chen Qingyue as you fear, senior brother, what reason does junior sister Chen have for not returning to the sect to resume her life?"
"The mission failed and her fellow apprentice died tragically. She was imprisoned for three to four months at most. Why is she still hiding and not daring to come back?"
Wang Tianquan was silent and did not think of a reasonable explanation.
Naturally, these two people didn't know that for Chen Qingyue, the sect's crime was a minor one, and three months of confinement was an unacceptable result.
Because in another month, the third stone door will be opened.
Chen Qingyue would never allow the most important Black Lotus Immortal Fate to fall into the hands of others.
That's why she returned to Liuzhou City and found an unlucky guy to replace Wei Qiancheng.
There is no need to hide it for a lifetime, just hiding it for a while is enough.
No one in the sect can recognize Wei Qiancheng. As long as he waits for a month for the Black Lotus Stone Gate to open, Chen Qingyue can secretly take away the immortal fate.
Then, the sea is wide enough for fish to leap, and the sky is high enough for birds to fly.
The world is so big, where can’t she go?
As for the unlucky guy who stayed in Taiyi Sect, he could only seek happiness and fend for himself.
Wang Tianquan raised his eyes and said slowly: "I suspect that Junior Sister Chen found some clues after killing that guy, so she didn't dare to go back to the mountain."
Liu Qiyuan shrugged and asked, "Wouldn't that be better?"
"As long as she doesn't return to Taiyi Sect, it doesn't matter where she escapes. The time is coming anyway..."
Wang Tianquan nodded slightly, he was right.
